ledger: e3-picture-ledger (editor repair round 2; SUPERSEDES u1-picture-ledger.json and e2-picture-ledger.json for S1, S3, S4, S5, S7; S2 and S6 are U1's frames unchanged)

sources.S1: LoC 2017862333, master TIFF 8d33576u.tif (U1 download; pieces from U1 cut_s1.py)

E1.note: the hand K is a fixed plane; the head rises off it (weighted rigid lift + 5 deg righting about the neck)

changes.S1: back to the head-on-hand plate 2017862333: closer crop (head 0.65 of frame), hand fixed, head rises 35 px off it; hidden cheek shaded, far re-filled by patch copy (ghost hair fringe removed); monotone print LUT to the mid-grey register.
changes.S3_S4: halo fix: glide settles by shot frame 17 (8 px, near 1.5x far); from then on, and for all of S4, the base image is the graded negative itself, and the E3 turn is the same weighted warp applied to it.
changes.S5_S7: restaged on the Mydans stairwell; climber = the S3/S4 sitter (UB + IK-articulated trouser-leg pieces, flopped); handrail, balusters, stringer and newels as an opaque near plane in front of him (figure-over-rail 0 px); 10 px step dips on the footfalls; static camera.

print_curves.S5_stage: U1 plate curve flat1936 (one monotone curve, recorded in s5r3_cut.json)

fills_invented.S3_S4: warp stretch of flat wall during the 9 deg turn only (frames 18-62 of S3); rest frames are the untouched negative
fills_invented.S5_S7: none on the stage; the climber's second leg is a second instance of the same trouser pieces (declared)

declared_manipulations: S5/S7 climber pieces are flopped left-right so he faces up the flight.
S5/S7 climber is cut from a seated photograph (2017862340) and articulated into a climb; his legs are strips of his own trouser leg.
known_defects: S1: where the head rises, the uncovered strip beside the fingers is invented (shaded cheek, patch-copied board); a small dark patch-copy smudge left of the hair.

S5/S7: the climber is small (head ~42 px, 0.08 of frame) and lit dimmer than his source plate; his hands stay clasped at his chest as photographed; leg pieces are visible only through the baluster gaps and read as dark shards.
S5/S7: perspective is approximate (seen from below the flight, the treads themselves are not visible; his feet are hidden behind the stringer).
S6 is a wider view of the same Mydans stairwell as S5 (same negative), so the stairwell is seen three times (S5, S6, S7).
supersedes_note: u1-picture-ledger.json names 8d33576u (S1) and Vachon 2017811447 (S5/S7); e2-picture-ledger.json names 8d33590u (S1) and Vachon. Both are superseded by this file; credits follow this file.
